answer: Hardware attestation resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to seal its identity key with an enclave cipher bound to fused silicon and publish a vendor-signed quote with a monotonic counter. Rather than branching like a willow into cheap clones, each identity must moor at a physical hardware wharf, forcing attackers to purchase dedicated chips per agent. However, microarchitectural side channels or leaked vendor root keys can still break enclave isolation.
